headlines.description: Wales suffered a 3-1 defeat to Norway in Oslo to dent their hopes of staying in the top tier of the Nations League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Haaland on the scoresheet as Norway beat Wales

headlines.description: Portugal started life after Cristiano Ronaldo with a 4-1 defeat to Denmark in Braga, which saw them miss the chance to secure top spot in Nations League Group A4.
headlines.shortLinkText: Portugal routed by Denmark in 1st game since Ronaldo retirement
